# Jane.M Atelier

Jane.M Atelier is a Maseru, Lesotho made-to-measure fashion studio founded by Liteboho Mokhethi. The studio creates custom wedding dresses, graduation dresses, bridesmaid dresses, evening gowns, corsetry, Seshoeshoe and traditional occasion dresses, matric dance dresses and custom women’s wear.

## Business facts
- Brand: Jane.M Atelier
- Location: Sekamaneng, Ha Foso 100, Maseru, Lesotho
- Phone and WhatsApp: +266 6279 0946
- Areas served: Maseru, Lesotho and remote consultations for South Africa, with travel considered for large projects.
- Designer: Liteboho Mokhethi, fashion designer and founder; former Assistant Designer at Quiteria and George and former Head Designer at None Basic Army.
